build_random_brightness_augmentation: build a RandomBrightnessOp transform with intensity_min and intensity_max kwargs from a JSON arg string
build_random_flip_augmentation: build a RandomFlipOp transform with a configurable probability from a JSON arg string
build_random_crop_augmentation: build a RandomCropOp or FixedSizeCropOp transform with crop_size kwargs from a JSON arg string
build_resize_scale_augmentation: build a ResizeScaleOp transform with min_scale, max_scale, target_height, and target_width kwargs
build_ssd_color_augmentation: build a RandomSSDColorAugOp transform using ColorAugSSDTransform with the config INPUT FORMAT
